fix.note: In speech 由 jau4 is more common for 'from'. 從來唔 = never.

ex.r: ngo5 cung4 sai3 zau6 zung1 ji3 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: I've loved swimming since I was little.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 cung4 tau4 zoi3 lai4 gwo3 laa1
ex.en: Let's start over from the beginning.

ex.r: keoi5 cung4 loi4 m4 sik6 laat6
ex.en: He never eats spicy food.

fix.note: Used like 月入三萬 = earns 30,000 a month.

ex.r: keoi5 jyut6 jap6 daai6 koi3 saam1 maan6
ex.en: He earns about thirty thousand a month.

ex.s: 月入兩萬喺香港好難捱。
ex.r: jyut6 jap6 loeng5 maan6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 naan4 ngaai4
ex.en: It's tough to get by in Hong Kong on twenty thousand a month.

ex.r: fan6 gung1 jyut6 jap6 gei2 do1 aa3
ex.en: How much does the job pay a month?

fix.en: to come and go; go in and out
fix.note: 出入平安 = safe travels (a blessing).

ex.r: ceot1 jap6 gei3 dak1 saan1 mun4
ex.en: Remember to close the door when you come and go.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 ceot1 jap6 jiu3 paak3 kaat1
ex.en: You need to tap your card to get in and out here.

ex.r: zuk1 nei5 ceot1 jap6 ping4 on1

fix.en: to feel for someone (happy or upset)
fix.note: 戥你開心 = happy for you; 戥佢唔抵 = feel it's unfair for him.

ex.s: 聽到你升職，我好戥你開心！
ex.r: teng1 dou2 nei5 sing1 zik1 ngo5 hou2 dang6 nei5 hoi1 sam1
ex.en: I heard you got promoted — I'm so happy for you!

ex.s: 佢咁辛苦都冇獎金，我戥佢唔抵。
ex.r: keoi5 gam3 san1 fu2 dou1 mou5 zoeng2 gam1 ngo5 dang6 keoi5 m4 dai2
ex.en: He worked so hard and got no bonus; I feel it's so unfair for him.

ex.s: 個女考到大學，我哋戥佢高興。
ex.r: go3 neoi2 haau2 dou2 daai6 hok6 ngo5 dei6 dang6 keoi5 gou1 hing3
ex.en: Our daughter got into university; we're so happy for her.

ex.r: ngo5 sau2 zoeng2 hou2 do1 hon6
ex.en: My palms are really sweaty.

ex.s: 佢喺我手掌寫咗佢個電話號碼。
ex.r: keoi5 hai2 ngo5 sau2 zoeng2 se2 zo2 keoi5 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5
ex.en: She wrote her phone number on my palm.

ex.r: ngo5 daa2 bo1 zing2 can1 sau2 zoeng2
ex.en: I hurt my palm playing ball.
